lines.say: One vote each. Play on, or leave it shut. Nobody says what they wrote. Whatever it says, that's it.
I don't want to do this.
You heard the man! Who's got the die? I've got the die!
Next one's the school. Same owl.
That card means wait a turn, not go twice. Read it again.
I have. Rule seven. Bash walks me home.
Two o'clock. He complains the whole way.
Eight years he did this by himself, and now he's got a curfew.
It's better. It's so much better.
That's it, isn't it? That's the end.
I don't know. It means... I don't know. Move the piece.
What's wrong with it? We did everything!
It stayed. Everything stayed. Why won't it...
So what? It's probably just lost.
Forty years, and nothing's ever been lost off this board. Every piece comes back. Everything goes back to where it was.
Something's missing. It's been missing the whole time.
But I've got a lot of notebooks. And I said I'd say things out loud.
